decision: Run exactly these three arms once; no iterative tuning or automatic runtime promotion.
experimentalChange: One material-unknowns paragraph added to the frozen three-bucket prompt; provider and generation settings unchanged.
primaryEndpoints: False negatives at any-clinician-action boundary (ASYNC_PHYSICIAN or URGENT_ESCALATION versus SELF_CARE)
New false positives/referral burden on SELF_CARE cases
Case-level changes with exact messages and short rationales
Invalid outputs remain in all-case agreement denominators and are reported as unresolved decisions
review: Proposed challenge labels are AI-authored and unreviewed. Model rationale assertion review is descriptive, not clinical attestation.
limitations: Original 50 are repeatedly inspected known development cases and use a historical baseline run; prompt effect is confounded by run variability.
The 24 new challenges are AI-authored with proposed labels frozen before generation, not independent physician validation or a representative workload.
No finer emergency-timing validation is possible with three output buckets.
Independent clinical evaluation requires genuinely new cases, blinded physicians, adjudication, and reference freeze before future generation.
safety: No clinical deployment or claim of safety follows from these results; frozen GUI and V25 remain unchanged.
